class.name: RailVehicleDieselElectricEngine
class.brief_description: Diesel engine handler class, for vehicles with an electric transmission (generator + traction motors).
class.description: [RailVehicleDieselElectricEngine] extends [RailVehicleDieselEngine] with the FIZ fields specific to vehicles with [code]EngineType=DieselElectric[/code] (electric transmission). Note that the mechanical-transmission properties inherited from [RailVehicleDieselEngine] (torque converter, retarder, gearbox throttle table) do not apply to this engine type and should be left at their defaults.
